name: nail-bar-ai-receptionist
description: Nail salon SaaS monorepo (web = Next.js platform, client = Vite storefront, server = Express API)

scripts.dev: npm run dev --workspace=server & npm run dev --workspace=client
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=client && npm run build --workspace=server
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace=client && npm --prefix web run lint
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=client && npm run typecheck --workspace=server && npm --prefix web run typecheck
